Business expense rules (Yarrow Logistics)
1. Corporate cards are issued on request; their monthly limit is EUR 7,500.00.
2. Other expense types: any type of expense not named in this policy is not reimbursed.
3. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be no more than EUR 25.00 (exactly EUR 25.00 is accepted); drinks containing alcohol are not paid for.
4. Private car: paid at EUR 0.42 per km driven; trips of more than 200 km are not paid at all (200 km itself is fine); the amount claimed must not be higher than km driven x rate.
5. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 30 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 30 is still in time).
6. Flights: economy class; business class is allowed only when the scheduled flight time is more than 4 hours (exactly 4 hours is not enough).
7. Equipment: an item costing EUR 200.00 or more needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
8. Taxis: below EUR 50.00 per ride (exactly EUR 50.00 is not accepted).
Only expenses that comply with every relevant rule are paid in full.

Business expense rules (Rivermark Engineering)
1. Mobile phone bills: no more than USD 90.00 per month (exactly USD 90.00 is accepted).
2. Corporate cards are issued on request; their monthly limit is USD 5,000.00.
3. Client gifts: no more than USD 25.00 per recipient (exactly USD 25.00 is accepted); gift vouchers and cash are never paid for.
4. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is USD 40.00 or more.
5. Team leads review expense reports once a week.
6. Employees may keep loyalty points earned on business trips.
7. Hotels: room rate below USD 150.00 per night (exactly USD 150.00 is not accepted).
8. Prior approval: an expense whose total is USD 750.00 or more is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

Ashgrove Partners: what we reimburse
1. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is CHF 75.00 or more.
2. Conference and training fees: always need prior approval, whatever the amount; at most CHF 1,500.00 per event (exactly CHF 1,500.00 is accepted).
3. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be no more than CHF 55.00 (exactly CHF 55.00 is accepted); drinks containing alcohol are paid for only when a client attended the meal.
4. This policy was last reviewed on 2026-04-17.
5. Other expense types: any type of expense not named in this policy is not reimbursed.
6. Expense reports are filed in the company's expense tool.
7. Equipment: an item costing more than CHF 200.00 needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
8. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 60 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 60 is still in time).
9. Approved expenses are paid with the next monthly salary.
Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

Expense claims at Halden Instruments: the rules
1. Approved expenses are paid with the next monthly salary.
2. Finance may ask for a short business reason for any expense.
3. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 90 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 90 is still in time).
4. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is above CAD 75.00 (CAD 75.00 itself does not count).
5. Conference and training fees: always need prior approval, whatever the amount; at most CAD 800.00 per event (exactly CAD 800.00 is accepted).
6. Exchange-rate differences are booked by finance and are never part of an expense.
7. Client gifts: no more than CAD 20.00 per recipient (exactly CAD 20.00 is accepted); gift vouchers and cash are never paid for.
8. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be no more than CAD 25.00 (exactly CAD 25.00 is accepted); drinks containing alcohol are paid for only when a client attended the meal.
9. Prior approval: an expense whose total is above CAD 750.00 (CAD 750.00 itself does not count) is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

8. Client gifts: no more than USD 20.00 per recipient (exactly USD 20.00 is accepted); gift vouchers and cash are never paid for.

Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

8. Parking: no more than CAD 25.00 per day (exactly CAD 25.00 is accepted).
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

Expense claims at Bellmont Software: the rules
1. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is USD 20.00 or more; private-car mileage never needs one.
2. Questions about this policy go to the finance team.
3. Expense reports are filed in the company's expense tool.
4. Prior approval: an expense whose total is above USD 400.00 (USD 400.00 itself does not count) is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
5. Flights: economy class; business class is allowed only when the scheduled flight time is 5 hours or more.
6. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 30 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 30 is still in time).
7. Hotels: room rate no more than USD 170.00 per night (exactly USD 170.00 is accepted); in Vienna, Seattle, Aarhus or Bilbao the limit is USD 220.00 per night instead, with the same rule at the limit.
8. Corporate cards are issued on request; their monthly limit is USD 5,000.00.
9. Private car: paid at USD 0.36 per km driven; trips of 500 km or more are not paid at all; the amount claimed must not be higher than km driven x rate.
10. Other expense types: a type of expense not named in this policy is reimbursed if it meets the rules on receipts, prior approval and deadlines in this policy.
11. Equipment: an item costing more than USD 100.00 needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

Expense claims at Quillfield Media: the rules
1. Private car: paid at CAD 0.38 per km driven; trips of 200 km or more are not paid at all; the amount claimed must not be higher than km driven x rate.
2. Expense reports are filed in the company's expense tool.
3. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is CAD 10.00 or more; private-car mileage never needs one.
4. Finance may ask for a short business reason for any expense.
5. Taxis: no more than CAD 30.00 per ride (exactly CAD 30.00 is accepted); a ride is paid only if it starts at 21:00 or later or before 07:00.
6. Prior approval: an expense whose total is above CAD 500.00 (CAD 500.00 itself does not count) is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
7. Hotels: room rate no more than CAD 120.00 per night (exactly CAD 120.00 is accepted); in Tallinn, Toronto, Porto or Rotterdam the limit is CAD 230.00 per night instead, with the same rule at the limit.
8. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 90 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 90 is still in time).
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.
